serviceName: Online store on your own domain
description: Points the apex domain (A @) and www (CNAME) to the Tezgah storefront servers and adds the ownership TXT record at _tezgah. IP and CNAME target are fixed; only the token varies.
variableDescription: %belirtec%: 32 hex characters of the store's ownership token (the TXT value is fixed to 'magazam-dogrulama=<token>').
